categories.name: Non-Critical Ward Admission
categories.description: Patient is admitted to a non-critical inpatient ward (Admission NC), supporting general recovery goals.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Admission NC (id=15) under the XOR decomposition of goal id=5. Evidenced in variants such as V0008, where Admission NC leads to ward care without critical unit escalation.

categories.name: Intensive Care Ward Admission
categories.description: Patient is admitted to an intensive care unit (Admission IC), which incurs a negative contribution profile for minimizing time-to-treatment due to heightened acuity.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Admission IC (id=16) under the XOR decomposition of goal id=5. Evidenced in variants like V0605 and V0317, realizing intensive care pathways with associated softgoal impacts.
